usage: Link to free primary-provider material for optional reading and prerequisite repair. Lessons, worked examples, investigations, and item banks are original. Do not copy provider figures, problem sets, or solutions. A verified URL is not independent subject review.

resources.title: BS Electrical and Computer Engineering course listing
resources.verified: Official current program page identifies PHS 231, credits, scope, and prerequisite wording.
resources.purpose: Curriculum alignment only; it is not a detailed syllabus.

resources.title: University Physics Volume 1: Units and Measurement
resources.verified: Chapter introduction and links to units, conversion, dimensional analysis, significant figures, and problem solving are available without payment.
resources.purpose: Supplement m01-l01; follow sections 1.2 through 1.7 as needed.

resources.title: SI Brochure: SI units
resources.verified: NIST primary reference on base and derived SI units.
resources.purpose: Check symbols, dimensions, and coherent derived units. Full metrology detail is optional.

resources.title: University Physics Volume 1: Products of Vectors
resources.verified: The section covers scalar and vector products and their physical interpretation.
resources.purpose: Supplement m01-l02, work, torque, and angular momentum; use preceding chapter sections for components.

resources.title: Finding Velocity and Displacement from Acceleration
resources.verified: Calculus-based kinematic development and initial conditions are available.
resources.purpose: Supplement m02-l01 and analytical checks in m09.

resources.title: Displacement and Velocity Vectors
resources.verified: The section includes vector trajectories and their components.
resources.purpose: Supplement m02-l02 and lead into projectile and relative motion sections.

resources.title: Drag Force and Terminal Speed
resources.verified: Primary-provider discussion of drag models and terminal motion is available.
resources.purpose: Supplement m03-l03; distinguish linear and quadratic regimes.

resources.title: Gravitational Potential Energy and Total Energy
resources.verified: The section addresses gravitational potential, energy references, and escape.
resources.purpose: Supplement m04-l02 and m05-l02; other chapter sections supply Newton's law and orbits.

resources.title: Elasticity and Plasticity
resources.verified: The section distinguishes elastic and plastic behavior and breaking behavior.
resources.purpose: Supplement m08-l03; the preceding section develops stress, strain, and modulus.

resources.title: 8.01SC Classical Mechanics
resources.verified: Free course with topic-organized instruction, videos, notes, and problems.
resources.purpose: Alternative instruction across vectors, motion, forces, circular motion, momentum, energy, rotation, equilibrium, and gravitation. Use topic labels, not an asserted NU week-to-week mapping.

resources.title: 18.01SC Single Variable Calculus
resources.verified: Free course with differentiation and integration units, examples, and practice.
resources.purpose: Prerequisite repair while CSC 208/209 lesson packs are under construction. It does not establish NU course equivalency.

maintenance: Recheck links and the official listing before a course release and whenever a reported change affects preparation, coverage, or credit units. Mark unavailable resources honestly and retain an alternative free route.
